You will help explore new product opportunities, shape the underlying AI architecture, and bring prototypes into production. Strong backend architecture skills and product intuition, with experience taking ideas from prototype through production. Experience building complex AI applications and applying machine learning in product or engineering settings, beyond simple retrieval-augmented generation. Product engineering experience in a fast-moving startup or growth-stage environment, with evidence of increasing scope or responsibility. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: $200,000 to $320,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. Location Remote within the United States. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/true-talent-solutions-partners-software-engineer-ai-agents
